## Workload

Elif Sahin completed grading work during 480 hours. The recorded workload was 1032 sets, equivalent to 2.1 sets per hour. This provides a clear summary of output against the available grading time and supports comparison of workload across the review period.

## Quality

A sample of 84 sets was read again to assess consistency. Agreement was 76.2 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases, with the review focusing on the consistency of grading decisions and the handling of less clear material.

The work was reviewed by Priya Anand.
